audit.whatIsWrong: All seven full-layer phases[].side read 'Skill' while content win[] reads Karma/Karma/Karma/Skill/Taliyah/Taliyah/Taliyah — the page answered 'who wins Level 1' two different ways.
audit.why: Content layer matches packet.levelChart. Karma's 950 Q and level-1 Mantra beat a Taliyah who has no stun until Unraveled Earth at 3; she takes over at 6 when Weaver's Wall (180/150/120s, up to 6500 range) turns her into a map threat.

audit.whatIsWrong: No real cooldown appeared anywhere and the level-6 spike was described as generic scaling.
audit.why: Seismic Shove 14/12.5/11/9.5/8s, Threaded Volley 7/6/5/4/3s, Unraveled Earth 14s flat, Weaver's Wall 180/150/120s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Content claimed 'Taliyah's combo requires wall proximity' and that her damage is 'wall-dependent'. That is fabricated — nothing in her kit needs a wall to combo.
audit.why: Rock Surfing gives Move Speed near walls; Worked Ground is created by her own Threaded Volley, not by terrain. The actual stun is Seismic Shove knocking you into Unraveled Earth's minefield ('If enemies dash through it or are knocked through it, the mines explode and stun them').
audit.corrected: content.early and spikes[0].text rewritten around the real W-into-E stun, plus dosFull[0].d and breakdown.cooldowns.
